==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Melee ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Ranged ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Magic ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Cookbook And Progression Wrapup Update - This Week In RuneScape|date=25 March 2024}}
** Cave bugs can now be selected as a task from [[Turael]]/[[Spria]] when using the [[Slayer master cape|Slayer Master Cape]] skillcape perk.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament &amp; Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=This Week In RuneScape: Yak To Basics and Ninja Strike 20!|date=1 March 2021}}
** The level 8 variant was made available to [[free-to-play]] players.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (3 May 2011)|date=3 May 2011}}
** This monster will no longer be assigned as a Slayer task to players with very low combat stats, and their regeneration rate has been lowered.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Lumbridge Swamp Caves|date=14 March 2005}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* This monster previously appeared on free-to-play worlds in the Taverley Slayer Dungeon, but it could not be killed because it requires a Slayer level of 7, while free players can only reach level 5.
* The large level 11 cave bugs were level 96 before the [[Evolution of Combat]].
* When a level 11 cave bug is killed, it appears to fall apart and explode.
